Coastal Waters Forecast
National Weather Service Honolulu HI
853 AM HST Tue Jul 28 2026

Hawaiian coastal waters within 40 nautical miles including the
Hawaiian Islands Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary.

PHZ100-290715-
853 AM HST Tue Jul 28 2026

.Synopsis for Hawaiian coastal waters...
Moderate to fresh NNE winds will be in place today as Tropical
Storm Fausto enters the far northeast offshore waters. As Fausto 
passes by, winds will be light and variable over the coastal 
waters, followed by south, then southeast immediately in its wake.
As Fausto moves off to the northwest and high pressure builds to 
the north, east-northeast trades will build back in on Thursday 
then strengthen to fresh to locally strong levels on Friday into 
the weekend. 

$$
